Act4-3#1.zh: 这不是鲁达大哥吗？为什么变成这付德性？
Act4-3#1.t: Isn't that Brother Lu Da? How did you end up looking like this?

Act4-3#2.zh: 喔！你不是史老弟吗？！等一下再叙旧，洒家先去把那个强盗头子修理一番！
Act4-3#2.t: Oh! If it isn't young Shi! We'll catch up later. First I'll go fix that bandit chief!

Act4-3#3.zh: 可是那个人已经连影子都看不见了...

Act4-3#4.zh: ...哈哈哈，这种人只有逃跑时最快；下次要是再看到他，洒家绝对不会让他跑掉。
Act4-3#4.t: ...Hahaha, his kind are only fast when running away. If I see him again, I won't let him get off.

Act4-3#5.t: ...Brother Lu, I think you could stand to lose some weight...

Act4-3#6.zh: 啊～～高僧啊，你怎么把那强盗头目打跑了呢？！原本不是说要用佛法劝说他回心转意？现在他一定是去聚集庄外的小喽罗准备报复；村里只有一些老弱残兵，哪里抵挡的住那些凶神恶煞啊！
Act4-3#6.t: Aah, holy one, why did you beat the bandit chief away?! Weren't you going to use the Dharma to persuade him? Now he's surely gathering his men outside to take revenge, and the village has only the old and the weak. How can we hold off those fiends!

Act4-3#7.zh: 太公，太公，大事不好了！那些强盗们开始攻击了！
Act4-3#7.t: Master, master, disaster! The bandits are attacking!

Act4-3#8.zh: 完了，全完了...老汉一定死在这里了...
Act4-3#8.t: It's over, all over... I'm going to die here...

Act4-3#9.zh: 喝！罗嗦！这些强盗洒家还看不在眼中！来一百个杀一百个！看洒家用佛法引渡这些无知小辈！
Act4-3#9.t: Bah! Enough fuss! These bandits are nothing to me! A hundred come, a hundred fall! Watch me ferry these ignorant brats across with the Dharma!

Act4-3#11.zh: 周通引兵报仇，众英雄各施绝技！
Act4-3#11.t: Zhou Tong leads his men for revenge, and our heroes show their skills!
